decisions.reason: The source's material-treatment constraint and temporary black-and-white sequencing are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and DEFER Events; no additional value change or removal is required.
The E and L letterforms were already deferred while the V system is resolved, and this source does not change their construction requirements or lifecycle further.

Further investigation of the Hero V's right arm does not change the existing requirement that the É accent derive from the Hero V geometry; the source establishes no new accent-specific correspondence.
The source refines the opening Hero V without changing the closing V's existing obligation to use the shared V-system geometry.
Kerning work was already deferred pending resolution of the V system, and the source neither changes the kerning goal nor creates a new lifecycle transition.
